channel.title: Comments on: Google Mail Downtime
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Actually for the last couple of hours, I have had problems, and it seems to come and go. Error code 717 when trying to send or save mail in GMail.

The problem seems only for my personal account. I have two others that are working just fine.

item.description: TIP 2: gmail.com does the same thing :)
